# EOS R05 strict client design fixtures

`cases.json` freezes EOS-owned startup, profile, health, movement and restart cases against the [EOS MuJoCo adapter contract](../../../docs/eos/interfaces/mujoco.md). The checker validates the matrix shape; focused Rust and real-child tests provide behavioral evidence, with independent review and cross-owner qualification still open. The MuJoCo package owns the socket framing, feature and error codes in its `tests/fixtures/strict_socket/` matrix. EOS owns graph-to-device binding, the direct-child flag, readiness proof, durable outcome and no-retry behavior. The local explicit launch still uses strict mode but has no IsOS P01 receipt, and the historical `1.0.0` TOML example remains a read-only migration fixture.

The implementation must run a bounded stub health server for negative startup cases, a real verified MuJoCo child for the positive boundary, and a durable journal restart case for uncertain movement. It must count physical socket releases where the fixture requires zero or one. `r06-stop-open` prevents R05 qualification from being mistaken for preemptive stop or separate base/arm acknowledgment. Full test output belongs in ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`.
